newsitem.title: ITALY: Swiss post office to expand into Italy then France.
newsitem.headline: Swiss post office to expand into Italy then France.

text.p: The Swiss Post Office plans to expand into the Italian and French postal markets, Giovanni Papagno commercial director and vice director general of Swiss Post, Italy told a press conference.
Swiss Post wants to have 245 "collection points" in Italy by June 1998 with a target of handling five percent of Italy's outgoing overseas mail.
It will start operating in France on July one when it opens an office in Lyons but Papagno gave no further details.

Swiss Post PTT has been in the Italian market since January 1995, through its affiliate "Mondial Sped". On June 20 its Italian operating subsidiary changes its name to Swiss Post International (Italy)S.r.l..
It offers a special postcard service which allows tourists to mail postcards for 1,000 lire (59 cents) to anywhere in the world. Last year it handled 20,000 cards.

Swiss Post PTT fees are 20-30 percent higher than the national Italian post. Swiss Post offers an average delivery time of 4-6 days to Europe and from 7 to 12 days for the rest of the world, Papagno said. The Italian national post has a reputation for being erratic and slow.
Swiss Post's main Italian hub is in Liscate, near Milan where two million items of mail were handled last year.

"The service we offer in Italy is half way between that of the Italian national post and the large express courier services. We pick up mail from the customer as the express couriers do, but our prices are as much as ten times lower, and guarantee the security and efficiency that Swiss Post is famous for," Papagno said.

"Of course, we are the first to recommend the services of express couriers for important documents needing special treatment. Our goal is to guarantee quality service and equal treatment to both large companies and private customers", he added. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
